nodes.label: ADR-001: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Solo-developer MVP heading to SaaS; microservices add operational tax, network overhead and cross-service coordination. Single FastAPI app gives high velocity, trivial local setup, single DB transaction boundary; shared memory risk mitigated by strict module boundaries under apps/api/src/qa_agentos/modules/.

nodes.label: ADR-002: LangGraph Orchestration & Checkpointing
nodes.rationale: Agentic QA workflows need determinism, persisted state across interruptions, human-in-the-loop approvals and replayability; LangGraph provides graphs, deterministic transitions and Postgres checkpointing. Learning curve mitigated by standardizing on generic_react graph.

nodes.label: ADR-003: Registries as Versioned Data
nodes.rationale: Adding new QA agents/tools should not require rewriting the control plane or redeploying; versioned DB records allow dynamic registration and immutable history for replay, at the cost of strict JSON Schema (Pydantic) validation at boundaries.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Model Gateway via LiteLLM Proxy
nodes.norm_label: adr-004: model gateway via litellm proxy
nodes.rationale: Agents need capability-slot routing, spend tracking, virtual keys, rate-limit fallback chains and one endpoint over many providers; self-hosted LiteLLM with OpenAI-compatible API lets providers be swapped via YAML and unifies cost/latency logging, at the cost of an extra proxy container.

nodes.label: ADR-005: NVIDIA NIM & Fallback Providers
nodes.rationale: NVIDIA NIM hosted endpoints cut LLM costs during bootstrapping; free-tier catalogs deprecate models, so gateway fallbacks (Gemini) are mandatory.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Hosted NIM
nodes.rationale: Primary provider for dev economics; free tier (~1000 credits, ~40 RPM) is a dev accelerator, not production (ADR-005)

nodes.label: pgvector
nodes.rationale: Adequate to ~50M vectors; zero new infra; dedicated vector DB deferred

nodes.label: Playwright Browser Automation (dual-mode)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic specs for regression; MCP for exploration - an MCP transcript is not a regression suite (ADR-011)

nodes.label: LangGraph Postgres Checkpointer
nodes.rationale: thread_id = run_id makes runs resumable and replayable

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 17 + JSONB
nodes.rationale: System of record for everything relational; MongoDB rejected for transactional integrity (ADR-007)

nodes.label: Redis (cache, rate limits, SSE pub/sub)
nodes.rationale: Reduced role because Hatchet owns the queue; smaller blast radius (ADR-009)

nodes.label: Run Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: queued->preparing->running->awaiting_approval/healing->succeeded/failed->reported; every transition persisted

nodes.label: Hardened Docker Runner Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Sufficient while targets are yours; escalate to gVisor/E2B when untrusted input arrives (ADR-019)

nodes.label: runs table
nodes.rationale: Runs pin agent_version_id and resolved_models snapshot for reproducibility

nodes.label: Schemathesis Property-Based Fuzzing
nodes.rationale: Spec-driven coverage no human enumerates, paired with LLM example cases (ADR-014)

nodes.label: Secrets Management (SOPS -> Infisical)
nodes.rationale: Vault too heavy for one operator; user tokens Fernet-encrypted (ADR-018)

nodes.label: Security Architecture (authority minimization + evidence)
nodes.rationale: Threat model is agent misusing legitimate authority or untrusted content steering it

nodes.label: SSE Run Event Streaming
nodes.rationale: One-way stream, proxy-friendly, auto-reconnect via Last-Event-ID; WebSockets deferred (ADR-010)

nodes.label: Tool Registry
nodes.rationale: Every tool has one contract (JSON Schema I/O, permissions, timeout, retry) so bad args never execute and garbage never reaches agents

nodes.label: Visual Baselines (approval-gated promotion)
nodes.rationale: Baselines in object storage, not Git; promotion is a human act (ADR-013)

nodes.label: Single VPS + Docker Compose Deployment
nodes.rationale: $6-20/mo, one operator, restore drills over HA theater (ADR-020)

nodes.label: Workflow Engine (event -> workflow DAG)
nodes.rationale: Thin deterministic DAG over agent invocations; nondeterminism lives inside agents; when-expressions sandboxed, no LLM in routing

nodes.label: Capability Slots (agents request capabilities, not models)
nodes.norm_label: capability slots (agents request capabilities, not models)
nodes.rationale: Decouple agents from models; provider outage becomes a routing event, not a deploy

nodes.label: FastAPI Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Solo maintainability; workers are the only scale axis; modules are future split lines (ADR-001)

nodes.label: Tenant-Shaped Schema
nodes.rationale: Cheap now, existential to retrofit; tenancy features deferred to Phase 3 (ADR-021)

nodes.label: Self-Healing (actions heal, assertions never heal)
nodes.rationale: Healed assertions would mask real regressions; confidence gate >= 0.75, every heal logged (ADR-012)

nodes.label: Tool Dispatch Pipeline
nodes.rationale: validate -> permission -> rate limit -> timeout -> retry -> validate output -> record; typed errors let agents reason about failures
